messages:
alisha: Heads-up: JIT SAML provisioning started dropping roles for several users after yesterday's RBAC refactor. Getting 403s in the app when users should be admins. Anyone else seeing this?
matt: saw alert from smoke tests. reproduce steps?
alisha: steps: sign in via Okta -> app redirect -> user created by JIT, but role attribute empty. Okta assertion includes groups claim but ordering was different (primary group last).
sarah: do we log the SAML claims into audit? I only see user create events but no role_mapping events.
jordan: oncall, looking. can you paste sample assertion (sanitized)?
alisha: pasted sanitized snippet below (removed IDs):
```xml
<saml:Assertion xmlns:saml="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:assertion">
  <saml:AttributeStatement>
    <saml:Attribute Name="groups">
      <saml:AttributeValue>developers</saml:AttributeValue>
      <saml:AttributeValue>admins</saml:AttributeValue>
    </saml:Attribute>
  </saml:AttributeStatement>
</saml:Assertion>
```
matt: aha — our mapping logic assumes first group is primary due to a prior Okta claim transform. The RBAC refactor changed the mapping to only check index 0. That would drop admin if it's not first.
sarah: that's a bug. Also our audit pipeline filters out role_mapping events when role list is empty, so we have zero trail for these failed assignments. We should emit a "mapping_missing" audit event.
alisha: quick mitigation: adding a fallback in the auth service to scan the whole groups list for any admin-like values before creating user. Pushing patch now to staging.
jordan: oncall note: created incident INC-2026-042 and paged infra. rolling back mapping change might be safer if patch fails.
matt: i'll open rollback PR for the mapping change and add a unit test for unordered groups. Also adding a regression eval.
sarah: KMS note: audit signer in staging showed a deprecated key version warning earlier. If audit events are unsigned we could lose downstream integrity. Rotating to key v2 as part of the incident tasks.
okta-bot: Okta analytics: 32 recent assertions for this app; 8 had groups claim order reversed (admins not first).
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created by alisha. Severity: P2. Affected: RBAC assignments. Channels: eng-security, oncall.
alisha: thanks all. will monitor deploys and post updates. :thumbsup:
